name: Functional - /query endpoint returns evidence when knowledge base has data
description: Ensures that the /query endpoint returns a successful evidence-based answer when relevant chunks are available.
input: HTTP POST request to /query endpoint (no body required); knowledge base contains relevant data
output: QueryResponse with success=True, answer containing evidence, error=None, error_code=None
success_criteria: answer is a non-empty string and not the fallback message
error_scenarios: Response is fallback message despite available data
